text:
Nora: quick notes from today's mini design sync on the playground schema inspector. main issues: cramped layout for long function defs, copy affordance, and a run-history replay glitch. jotting decisions here. :memo:
Ben: saw the copy icon disappear on narrow viewports when functions have lots of params. users can't easily copy example payloads. :clipboard:
Carlos: repro for run-history glitch: when opening an old run with tool calls the inspector sometimes renders empty until you collapse/expand the tool. likely lazy-load/virtualization mismatch. steps:
```
- Playground -> Run history
- open entry with tool invocation
- expand tool block
- inspector shows blank until toggle
```
Mei: proposal: default to a compact modal inspector with a "Pop out" button that detaches to a persistent right-side panel. modal minimizes layout shift, detach supports side-by-side comparisons.
Ben: also make the copy action an explicit text button "Copy example" (icon + label) so it's discoverable and works with screen readers.
Carlos: dev notes: reuse ui/prettyJSON for formatting, paginate very large schemas (>150 lines), and fix the lazy import so expanded run-history entries render schema immediately.
Mei: microcopy: change CTA from "View schema" to "Open request schema (read-only)" and add a small hint below: "Tip: press \u2318/Ctrl+C to copy example."
Ben: copy feedback: replace ephemeral tooltip with an aria-live polite region that announces "Example copied" and remains programmatically present until next copy. also support Cmd/Ctrl+C keyboard when code block focused.
LintBot: color scan: clipboard icon #97A2B0 fails AA at 12px. recommend #5C6670 or bump to 14px. also ensure focus-visible ring exists.
Mei: keyboard flow: focus search on open, Tab order -> fold toggles -> pagination -> copy -> close, Esc closes. detached panel keeps same shortcuts and persists preference in sessionStorage.
Nora: owners & follow-ups for next sprint:
- Carlos: fix run-history hydration + eager render for expanded tool blocks (owner)
- Mei: prototype modal + detach + microcopy updates (owner)
- Ben: implement copy button (text+icon), aria-live announcement, keyboard shortcut (owner)
- Design: update tokens for icon color and add CI check (owner: Nora)
Please add time estimates in the ticket RD-UX-3491 and we'll triage. :+1:
Mei: quick poll 1F31F5 react with :one: modal default, :two: panel default.
Ben: :one:
Carlos: :one:
Nora: :one: (modal default + detach)
LintBot: created ticket RD-UX-3491 "Playground request schema inspector: modal default + detach, copy accessibility + run-history hydration" and linked this thread.
